summary: Compact rectangular motor controller in a black enclosure. The top face has diagonal heatsink fins. One short end face carries three status LEDs (ER, S1, S2), a micro USB port and a 10-pin CTRL header. A bundle of four wire leads (green, yellow, black, red) exits the opposite end.

mountingSurfaces.description: Connector end face with the LEDs, micro USB port and 10-pin CTRL header. This is an interface face, not a confirmed mounting face.
Top finned heatsink face. It is ribbed, so it is not a flat mounting surface.

notes: The images show no printed dimensions. The bounds above are therefore a proportional estimate, and the absolute scale must be checked against a datasheet. Axes: x is length, y is width, z is height, centered on the part.
